cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), cousin Sam (10), Dad, Uncle Ben and the puppy Max. Sports shown in action; equipment shown on its own.

words.scene: Two children playing badminton in a garden, a white shuttlecock flying over a low net.
more: Badminton is fun in the garden.
在花园里打羽毛球很有趣。

words.scene: One bright red and yellow beach ball bouncing on grass.

words.sz: Sam 每个星期六打棒球。
words.scene: A child in a baseball cap hitting a white baseball with a wooden bat on a sunny field.
A child jumping to throw an orange basketball into a hoop on an outdoor court.

words.en: Hit the ball with the bat!
words.scene: One wooden cricket bat and a red cricket ball lying on green grass.
more: Sam has a new cricket bat.
Sam 有一根新的板球拍。
Lily has a new bathing suit.
Put your bathing suit in your bag.

words.en: We play on the beach in summer.
more: The beach is very busy today.
Max loves running on the beach.

words.en: Lily rides her bicycle to school.
words.scene: One shiny green bicycle with a basket on the front and a bell.

words.en: Tom has a new red bike.
words.sz: Tom 有一辆新的红色自行车。
words.scene: Tom riding a small red bike along a park path with a helmet on, Max running beside him.
more: Let's go for a bike ride.
I go to school by bike.

words.en: We go on a boat on the lake.
words.scene: A small wooden rowing boat on a calm lake, Dad rowing and Lily trailing her hand in the water.
more: The boat is red and white.

words.scene: Tom jumping up to catch a ball with both hands, his face full of concentration.
more: Max can catch a ball in his mouth.

words.scene: Lily climbing a colourful indoor climbing wall with a helmet and a safety rope, looking down and smiling.

words.en: Tom is in the swimming club.
words.sz: Tom 参加了游泳俱乐部。
words.scene: A group of children in matching T-shirts at a swimming club, smiling with their coach by the pool.
more: Our football club meets on Friday.
我们的足球俱乐部周五聚会。
Do you want to join the club?
你想加入这个俱乐部吗？

words.en: Our football coach is very kind.
words.sz: 我们的足球教练人很好。
more: The coach helps us play better.
We go to London by coach.
我们坐长途大巴去伦敦。
senses: We go to London by coach.

words.sz: Lily 在一次绘画比赛中获胜。
words.scene: Children at a painting competition, a judge holding up a gold cup, the winner smiling with her painting.
more: There is a swimming competition today.
Do you want to enter the competition?

words.scene: Children playing cricket on a sunny green field, one batting, one bowling, wooden wickets behind.
more: 爸爸看电视上的板球比赛。

words.scene: A family cycling together along a country lane, all wearing helmets, Max in a basket.
more: I love cycling in the park.

words.scene: Lily walking through a door into a big sports hall, a sign with only a picture of a running person over the door.
more: Lily wants to enter the race.
You can enter the park at nine.

words.sz: 爷爷每个星期天都去钓鱼。
words.scene: Grandpa and Tom fishing from a wooden pier on a calm lake at sunrise, two rods and a bucket.
more: Let's go fishing on the lake.

words.scene: Children playing football on a green pitch, one kicking the black and white ball towards a goal.
more: 足球是我最喜欢的运动。

words.en: Sam wants to be a football player.
words.scene: A grown-up football player in a red kit kicking a ball in a big stadium, the crowd cheering.
more: He is a famous football player.
他是一位著名的足球运动员。
The football player scores a goal.
那名足球运动员进了一个球。

words.scene: A family playing a board game at the table with dice and coloured counters, everyone laughing.
A football flying into the back of a goal net, the goalkeeper diving the wrong way.
more: The ball is in the goal.

words.sz: 爷爷星期六打高尔夫球。
words.scene: Grandpa playing golf on a green course, a little white ball rolling towards a hole with a red flag.
more: 高尔夫是一项安静的运动。

words.scene: Two girls playing hockey on a field with curved sticks, chasing a small white ball.
more: 我们星期三有曲棍球课。
曲棍球是一项快节奏的运动。
My kit is in my bag.
Our team has a new red kit.
我们队有了新的红色队服。

words.scene: Lily holding a green four-leaf clover and crossing her fingers, smiling hopefully.

words.en: Lily is a member of the swimming club.
words.sz: Lily 是游泳俱乐部的会员。
words.scene: A happy child receiving a club membership card with only a star on it, other club members clapping.
more: How many members are in your team?

words.scene: Lily, Tom and Max playing happily together in the garden, throwing a ball and laughing.
senses: We see a play at the theatre.

words.en: He is a very good player.
words.scene: A smiling young tennis player in white holding a racket, ready for the ball.
more: There are eleven players in a team.

words.en: The children swim in the pool.
words.scene: A bright blue outdoor swimming pool with lanes, a diving board and a few children swimming.
more: The pool is very cold today.

words.en: Lily practises the piano every day.
more: Practise your English with a friend.
Tom practises football in the garden.

words.scene: Lily holding a gold cup prize on a little stage, ribbons and confetti around her.
more: The prize is a new bike.

words.scene: Children running a race on a school sports day, Tom breaking the finishing tape with his arms up.
more: Let's have a race to the tree.
我们比赛跑到那棵树吧。
The race starts at ten o'clock.

words.scene: One tennis racket with yellow strings and a yellow tennis ball beside it.
more: This racket is too heavy for me.
这个球拍我拿着太重了。

words.scene: Lily and Max resting under a tree after a long walk, lying on the grass with eyes closed.
more: Grandpa has a rest after lunch.
爷爷午饭后休息一会儿。

words.scene: Lily riding a brown pony in a field with a riding helmet, a grown-up instructor leading the pony.
more: We go for a ride in the car.

words.sz: Lily 每个星期六去骑马。
words.scene: A riding lesson in a sandy arena, two children on ponies following a grown-up teacher.
more: 骑马是我最喜欢的运动。
I have a riding lesson today.

words.scene: Children playing rugby on a muddy field, one running with an oval ball under his arm.
Lily running fast along a park path, her hair flying, Max running happily beside her.
more: I run in the park every morning.
我每天早上在公园跑步。

words.en: We go sailing in the summer.
words.scene: A small white sailing boat on a sparkling blue sea, Dad and Lily in life jackets steering it.
more: Sailing is fun on a windy day.
有风的日子玩帆船很有趣。

words.scene: Lily skating on a frozen lake in winter wearing ice skates, a scarf and a hat, arms out for balance.
more: We skate on the ice in winter.

words.scene: One colourful skateboard with bright wheels lying on a path.
A child skiing down a snowy slope with skis and poles, goggles on, snow spraying.
A family on a skiing holiday on a sunny snowy mountain, skis on, a ski lift behind them.
more: I love skiing with my family.
我喜欢和家人一起滑雪。

words.sz: Sam 有一块红色滑雪板。
words.scene: One colourful snowboard standing upright in the snow.
more: My snowboard is in the car.
This snowboard is too long for me.
这块滑雪板我用太长了。

words.scene: A teenager snowboarding down a snowy slope, leaning into a turn, snow flying.

words.en: In America, football is called soccer.
words.scene: Children in yellow shirts playing soccer on a pitch, one about to kick the ball.
more: Soccer is popular all over the world.
足球在全世界都很流行。

words.scene: A collage of sports balls and equipment on the grass: a football, a tennis racket, a basketball and a swimming cap.
more: We do sport every day at school.
我们在学校每天都做运动。

words.en: We swim at the sports centre.
words.scene: A big modern sports centre building with glass windows, people going in with sports bags and rackets.
more: The sports centre opens at nine.
Let's meet at the sports centre.

words.en: The stadium is full of people.
words.scene: A huge football stadium full of cheering fans in red and blue, bright lights and a green pitch.
more: We watch football at the stadium.
The new stadium is very big.

words.scene: A grown-up surfer riding a big blue wave on a surfboard, spray flying.
more: I want to learn to surf.
They surf in the sea every day.
他们每天都在海里冲浪。

words.scene: One long bright surfboard with a stripe, standing in the sand on a beach.
more: Carry your surfboard to the sea.

words.en: Surfboarding is fun in the summer.
words.scene: A group of surfers on surfboards waiting for waves on a sunny sea, one standing up riding a wave.
more: We go surfboarding at the beach.

words.scene: A girl of about nine in a red swimming costume and goggles swimming front crawl across a blue pool, one arm out of the water, splashes around her.
Children having a swimming lesson in an indoor pool, a coach standing at the side.
more: I love swimming in the sea.

words.en: Lily puts on her swimming costume.
The swimming pool is near my school.
words.scene: An indoor swimming pool with clear blue water, lane ropes, a slide and a lifeguard chair.
more: Is the swimming pool open today?
There's a big swimming pool in the park.
公园里有一个大游泳池。
Put your swimsuit in your bag.

words.scene: Lily and Tom playing table tennis at a green table with a net, a small white ball in the air.
more: Table tennis is popular in China.
I play table tennis with my brother.
我和弟弟一起打乒乓球。

words.scene: A children's football team in matching blue kit standing together for a team photo, arms around each other.
more: There are eleven players in a football team.
一支足球队有十一名队员。
Tom is in the school team.

words.scene: Two children playing tennis on a red clay court, a yellow ball flying over the net.
more: 网球是我最喜欢的运动。
Let's play tennis in the park.

words.en: She is a famous tennis player.
words.sz: 她是一位著名的网球运动员。
words.scene: A grown-up tennis player in white jumping to hit the ball, a big stadium crowd watching.
more: The tennis player hits the ball hard.
那位网球运动员用力击球。
I want to be a tennis player.

words.scene: Tom throwing a red ball high across the garden, Max jumping to catch it.
more: Don't throw your rubbish on the floor!

words.en: I have two tickets for the football match.
words.sz: 我有两张足球比赛的票。
words.scene: Two colourful tickets with only a star and a little football drawn on them, held in a child's hand.

words.en: I'm very tired after the race.
words.scene: Tom yawning and very tired after football, slumped on the sofa in his kit, Max asleep on his lap.
more: Max is tired after his walk.
Are you tired? Go to bed.
Max has my trainer in his mouth!
Max 把我的运动鞋叼在嘴里！
I need new trainers for football.
我踢足球需要一双新运动鞋。

words.en: Today's game is Lily's school v Tom's school.
words.sz: 今天的比赛是 Lily 的学校对 Tom 的学校。
words.scene: A big scoreboard at a school sports field showing two team badges, a red lion and a blue eagle, with a large VS between them, no other writing.
more: It's red team v blue team.
谁赢了？英格兰对法国那场？

words.en: We play volleyball on the beach.
words.scene: Children playing volleyball on a sandy beach, one jumping to hit the white ball over the net.

words.en: Lily takes Max for a walk.
words.sz: Lily 带 Max 去散步。
words.scene: Lily walking Max on a lead along a country path on a sunny day.
more: We walk in the park every evening.
我们每天晚上在公园散步。
What time is it? Look at your watch.

words.en: I want to win the race!
words.scene: Tom's football team jumping and cheering with a gold cup, confetti falling.
A windsurfer on a board with a colourful sail skimming across a windy blue sea.
more: 爸爸度假时尝试了帆板运动。

words.scene: A happy child standing on the top step of a winners' podium with a gold medal, two others on the lower steps clapping.
more: Who is the winner of the race?
